verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs say the open-source server ships under GPL-3.0. The public typesense/typesense GitHub repository is cited, and a community commenter confirms the C++ source is simple enough to skim. missing for 10: a direct citation of the repository's LICENSE file (the GPL-3.0 claim comes from a vendor comparison page), explicit docs on browsing or building from source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The complete API surface is available in the open-source server under GPL-3.0.
